comment_data.body:
> It works with other LSPs, but for bashls, settings is successfully applied while filetypes is completely ignored.

are those "other lsps" also configured via a `lsp/foo.lua` file in your personal config?

i'm just guessing because i didn't study your config, but if you have both lspconfig and a personal `lsp/*.lua` then the "merging semantics" apply: https://github.com/neovim/neovim/issues/33577

and the load-order also matters.

@justinmk 

First of all, my `lua_ls` configuration was incorrect. `filetypes` should be at the same level as `settings`, and it cannot be configured as well.

Secondly, I believe this is an issue with `vim.tbl_deep_extend` when merging two arrays:

```lua
vim.tbl_deep_extend("keep", {"zsh", "bash"}, {"bash", "sh"}) -> {"zsh", "bash"}
```

It overrides the options instead of merging them. This actually makes total sense since they are arrays.

Lua treats everything as a table, there is currently no way to merge arrays properly.

Therefore, configurations outside of `settings` (such as `root_markers`, `filetypes`, etc.) cannot be merged properly by lspconfig and will only be overridden.

> Secondly, I believe this is an issue with `vim.tbl_deep_extend` when merging two arrays:

yeah, exactly. and the linked issue discusses the plan there.

title: `bashls` couldn't configure filetypes?
